name: skills
description: The constellation — one umbrella over the four version-coupled repos: the praxis process engine, the corpora judgment lifecycle, and the uiux design practice. (domains is a corpora data collection, imported per-root, not a plugin.)

plugins.name: praxis
plugins.description: Process/orchestration engine: frames a unit of work, composes context per phase, drives it through typed-edge workflows (or spawns it isolated), verifies at a barrier, and gates edits until a unit is framed.

plugins.name: corpora
plugins.description: Standalone composer/judgment system over domain-file artifacts: discovers and injects domains at prompt-assembly time, and grows the pool via a forward-pass harvest ask plus a reading front end.

plugins.name: uiux
plugins.description: Standalone design-practice plugin: library state, screenshot staleness, the deferred-decisions queue, and design workflows — with a praxis adapter.
